physical_bound_policy.gray: No setup false path on source Gray -> first stage; max flight and skew <= actual producing period, both selected modes use stricter59.0514ns.

physical_bound_policy.single_bit: Only asynchronous first stage exception, keep synchronizer interstage timed; persistence/pulse rate and MTBF must be reviewed.

physical_bound_policy.fifo_payload: Pointer coherence is insufficient by itself; verify actual memory architecture, stable entry ownership and capture timing. Restart pointer jumps need explicit common hold/clear/drain proof.
